disambiguation: It is a rendering-time feature that displays definitions via hover cards, not a traditional note-based dictionary search tool.
extras: Fully local, no network requests, works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Users need a simple, local way to define and reference specialized terms within their vault without modifying source files or using external services.
summary: A local plugin that allows users to hover over terms in notes to display definitions read from a designated Markdown glossary file.
